title: aerva persica
intro: Aerva persica, commonly known as "Kanghwar" or "Kanghwat", is a type of herbaceous plant that belongs to the family Amaranthaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The health benefits of Aerva persica include reducing inflammation, improving insulin sensitivity, and protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage.
